verdict: key consistent: 78 signs = 78 letters of the verse as the cipher has it (without درر نثرن, with الفيروزج), 18 groups = 18 words; one letter per shape; ل has two shapes (S10; S2 once), ع two (S15 once, S22), ج two (S12 once, S21), و two (S1, S19 once)
notes: Rows: 10r segmenter lines 2-7 (the record's 2-7). Measured 15+14+13+13+14+9 = 78 signs (record 87) and 18 dividers (record 17); one divider (10r.3, between على and ارض) has a small x in place of its three dots. Record errors: (1) the cipher does NOT have 'درر نثرن': after كانها (S6 S9 S11 S14 S9) comes على (S15 S10 S16, S16 = ي as in يلمعن, تطاير, الفيروزج), then ارض, من; (2) the cipher has الفيروزج (8 signs: S9 S10 S18 S16 S7 S19 S20 S21, the ال and the ف S18, ج S21 exactly as in العرفج), not فيروزج. The enciphered first hemistich is therefore ولقد ذكرتك والنجوم كأنها على أرض من الفيروزج (short by درر نثرن: the encipherer skipped them or worked from a different text); the second hemistich matches the record. With this text signs = letters and groups = words with no surplus or dropped letter. The ر of الفيروزج (10r.4) is drawn as a d with its top hook detached beside it (z_r4mark.png), counted as one sign S7. S2 (λ, the ل of ولقد) is distinct from S14 (Λ, ه) at 3x.
